title: People who hate AI are immoral and bad human beings. Meanwhile we are making our dreams come true.
author: CanadianWinter20
selftext:
You have this beautiful technology that came from humans, learned from humans, adapted from humans and is being used to help humans. It is the most helpful technology in human history. It is a magical supercharged calculator that can help you in all manners of life. Whether it is for research, work, medicine, art, music, games, and so forth.  And because of how it was trained allows it to be this effective and exceptional.  It is an exploration of the best which humanity has to offer.

For gaming in particular I have had all these fantastic ideas in my head growing up but never had a way to apply them. I tried in starcraft which was a fantastic creative outlet but most games don't allow you to have that level of control to be able to create your own missions. So I was largely out of luck. Now thanks to AI I am able to make my dreams come true and I have never had more reason to be creative. Every single day I am coming up with new ideas and writing stories.   I have never been more creatively inclined in my life.  

So why reject it? Because of our pride? Our ego? Our jealousy and envy? Because a new tech came along that does art and everything else better than we can? Get over it. That is exactly what makes it so beautiful. So even your retired grandma can explore the beautiful world of art and now even she can ''paint'' like van gogh or in any art style she desires. A disabled person can get a new lease on life. Even single mothers can create custom art books featuring their kids over the course of a weekend. While some anti-ai goon will scream ''hire an artist'' like money grows on trees (how empathetic). Or the infamous ''learn to paint''.  Like life is just infinite and we don 't need to prioritize. I ask the ai haters: Why don't you learn to paint? Or play an instrument? Or Any other stupid demand you have of ai users. Because you know it's not time efficient and you have other priorities and passions. We all do. We all choose what is most important to us. The ai haters make demands of us that they themselves would never be interested in doing. I don't see them picking up an instrument yet they demonize us for making music with Suno? It's nonsense. It's one big gaslight after another. 

The point of ai is that you can complete any task and create something amazing in a shorter period of time so you have more opportunity to spend time with your loved ones and do the things that matter most to you. That is what makes creating an orchestra with words in 1 minute so beautiful. it allows you to explore more of what life has to offer and the experience of using ai can be so soulful if you realize that you are in fact getting human creations because after all everything it learned it learned from us.   The music that is resonating with me isn't some fake digital beep and boop. It is music that was generated based on intimate knowledge of what human music is actually like and the ai has intricate knowledge of human psychology and what it means to create music that resonates with our hearts.   

But regardless, if the AI is a magical calculator that helps us in all walks of life how Dare you or anyone criticize or demonize others for using it? You are trying to prevent ppl from improving their lives and that is sick and immoral.  You are actually just a BAD person. A bad human being if you recognize that "this technology helps people... and i don't care''.  You don't care about people. That's the issue.     It's ironic to me that the ai haters hate ai so much that they are willing to hate the humans who use it. They turn against humans in their deranged war against ai.   How very kind.   

At it's core the AI is a tool that helps people. If someone cannot find beauty in that then they cannot be a good person.  So take this ai debate as the GREATEST test of character of all time.  You get to see people's true colors in all of this.   Never forget that these people are the ones willing to even bully and dehumanize disabled artists who lost their ability to paint and committed the crime of using ai to supplement their income.  What is worse that they even accuse artists who Don't use ai of being ai users and demonize and bully them if they perceive their work to be ai.   This is what ai haters are all about. They are hateful and they are sick.  There is no empathy on display here. Only individualism and a bruised ego over a technology that does things better than they do and it makes them feel angry and inferior.  They simply do not care about others.   


 So ask yourself. Think long and hard. When was the last time you met a good person who was anti- ai?  Was it when they were bullying someone? Harassing them? Mocking them? Insulting them? Claiming superiority? Degrading someone for lack of talent?   When was it?   Can you think of the last time?   I can’t.    There is a universal truth here.   These are not good people. Their hatred of ai causes them to hate their fellow peers and lash out at them and harbor hatred in their hearts.  None of these are positive qualities.    We need to change the conversation and unite against this madness.  They painted us as the bad guys yet the truth is the complete opposite and all it takes is examining how each side behaves on a day to day basis.  

Meanwhile these ai haters are being left behind. But sadly they leave their families behind too because while mom is fighting cancer they could use the ai to conduct better research and yet they are too prideful and too hateful to even help their own families.  These are the true colors of the anti-ai movement.  

It's so sad too because when AI was starting to emerge I thought this would be the time where finally people can come together and we could create a better world. Something more beautiful thanks to this amazing progressive technology. Yet of course humanity would let me down because all of those toxic traits and of course all the negative propaganda would convince hundreds of millions to hate on something so beautiful. What a shame.  Maybe in 10 years we can have a shift in perspective.  

But in the meantime if you'd like to see one of my projects. Please check out my FREE vibe coded game featuring a lot of my own writing.  I'd love to know what you think!   It's a short form visual novel (short experiences)  featuring an innovative conversation cube system.   Alien Adoption Agency.
